Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's digivolution requirement to digivolve for a cost of 5 even when my [Koji Minamoto] has more than 5 [Hybrid] trait cards under it?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger when either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon attacks?

Card Q&A.a: No. Digivolve from the Tamer as such, and do not treat it as if it is a digivolving Digimon. "When digivolving" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.Additionally, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect has activated, you can still digivolve from a Tamer with this digivolve requirement.
Card Q&A.q: Does the digivolution requirement that this card digivolve from a Tamer mean the Tamer that becomes a digivolution card is treated as if it is a Digimon when digivolving?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you do.A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.
Card Q&A.q: Do I perform a digivolution bonus draw even if I digivolve from a Tamer?

Card Q&A.a: No, it can't. A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.
Card Q&A.q: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it is.If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards as the bottom security card, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the same level as the placed card.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When Digimon attack, by adding your top security card to the hand, this Digimon unsuspends.
